integrity: The bracket, Nijenhuis identity, automorphism condition, and six normal forms are independently reconstructed. The proof separates conjugacy classes by eigenspace dimension and incidence with the characteristic derived line. Finite-field enumeration over F3 and orbit generation over F5 replay the formulas without being used as the infinite-field proof.
scientific_limitations: The orbit classification assumes characteristic different from 2.
The finite-field census concerns the fixed nontrivial three-dimensional 3-Lie algebra, not arbitrary ternary algebras.
A differently phrased or unindexed orbit computation may exist.
title: Six product-structure orbits on the nontrivial three-dimensional \(3\)-Lie algebra
